reviews.comment: It's a powerful little thing. Definitely not top of the line, but for a smaller (2 fan, 8 pin) GPU, I'm very satisfied.
reviews.author: C B

reviews.title: Amazing product, don't buy the 8GB AMD RX 9060XT.
reviews.comment: Fortunately, I bought it at the price of a regular 5060, and I must say its performance is incredible. Perhaps the 8GB might be a bit of a snag in some games, but on ultra graphics with high textures everything flows smoothly, much better than its competitor, the RX 9060XT, and even surpasses the 16GB 9060XT in FPS.
reviews.author: Jean Carlos

reviews.title: Got it for $130 with an Amazon deal
reviews.comment: Nvidia doesn't care enough to make sure that the card works properly before you buy it. So if you bought this as a plug and play upgrade to your current system and thought you might not have to do anything... Well that's not really the case. It seems on forums that new builds take this graphics card great. But my driver's from AMD were causing the card to go to a black screen. You can fix this with a simple DDU before installing. Going into safe mode, removing your drivers. Power off and Install your card, (try gen 4 in the BIOS PCIe subsystem settings if nothing works) after that everything's been pretty smooth sailing. Performance is pretty good once you set your settings up right too.
reviews.author: Peyton

reviews.title: Good Deal.
reviews.comment: Running LLMs on this and with 8GB mem, like Llama3 will run and fit on the card.  Fans keep it between 30-40 degrees C.  Under a gaming load, I suspect this would go up to 50 C.  I'm using this in a micro AXT build, and it's perfect.  Good card at a good price.
